label: Kesong puti
note: The vinegar version is not fermented and is slightly sour, the rennet version is firmer. Salted in the milk or in brine afterwards, sold wrapped in banana leaf

about.text: A soft, unaged white cheese from the Philippines, made from unskimmed carabao (water buffalo) milk and salt, set with rennet, vinegar or citrus juice and traditionally sold wrapped in banana leaf.
